model: it5 twin of record (Karnopp Coulomb, command delay, gravity) + gear backlash: servo M4.dynamics.twin x3, chain M0.dynamics.rigid

sources.encoder_quantum_rad: the smallest position step in the real runs, 9.587e-5 rad = 2 pi / 65536 (/archive/datasets/bam_rig/rack_2026-11-10/ur_wrist/coverage/real/ram (CAN 15/16 floor-dither runs, measured 2026-11-11))
sources.encoder_noise_rad: 0: the real board's position at rest moves by whole steps only; the step is the encoder's noise
sources.velocity_noise_rad_s: the real board's velocity at rest: 1.1e-3 rad/s std (/archive/datasets/bam_rig/rack_2026-11-10/ur_wrist/coverage/real/ram (CAN 15/16 floor-dither runs, measured 2026-11-11))
sources.torque_noise_nm: the real torque at rest: 0.014 N.m std with the loop's own chatter in it (/archive/datasets/bam_rig/rack_2026-11-10/ur_wrist/coverage/real/ram (CAN 15/16 floor-dither runs, measured 2026-11-11)); bam_ur_wrist.refit's hidden twin used 0.01
sources.torque_disturbance_nm: 0 at 1x: anchored on the real lane's repeat floors (CAN 14 0.100, CAN 15 0.092, CAN 16 0.241 deg driven, bam_ws claude/ur-wrist-real @ 6e26aa27a), which the host loop's measured timing alone already reproduces to within about 2x (WristRig.floor_check); a disturbance raised CAN 15's floor 2x and left CAN 14's
sources.period_overrun_s: the real host loop: median 10.57 ms, mean 10.71 ms, std 0.53 ms against the plan's 10 ms tick (/archive/datasets/bam_rig/rack_2026-11-10/ur_wrist/coverage/real/ram (CAN 15/16 floor-dither runs, measured 2026-11-11))
sources.latency_jitter_s: 0 at 1x, set by the floor anchor (WristRig.floor_check against the real lane's floors, 2026-11-11): the host loop's measured overrun alone gives CAN 14 / 15 / 16 1.70x / 1.62x / 0.53x the real floors (geometric mean 1.13x); 0.4 ms of jitter took CAN 14 to 2.06x. Unmeasured on the bus; the term stays for the stress lane

steps.title: Backlash from slow reversals at a held pose (the output's own breakaway as the clamp)

steps.title: Breakaway from a held flank, both ways (the cap ramped until the output leaves)

Mount tilt: gravity's direction in the chain's base frame, from the joints' own gravity torques
Command delay from twin replays of the train chirps at a grid of delays

parameters.name: axis_inertia_kg_m2

tolerance.source: proposed: 10 % (the it5 refit's own indirect-inference gap closed to < 1 %)

parameters.method: bam_ur_wrist.refit.fit (equation error, 18,400 sliding rows of 50 train runs) + 8 indirect-inference iterations at a gain of 0.7 on the twin (last gap [0.000663, 2.4e-05, 0.000512, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.000116, 2.9e-05, 3e-05, -0.000354, -2.3e-05, -0.001647, 4e-05]); 95 % from a run bootstrap of the equation-error fit, shifted by the inference

parameters.name: armature_kg_m2
parameters.why_not: only the axis inertia is seen (armature + the links it turns: can14.axis_inertia_kg_m2): the CAD links' inertia is a prior the hidden masses move, so any error in it lands in the armature one for one (on CAN 14 the links carry twice its armature); the fit sets it for the twin as the axis inertia less the links at the twin's masses
